text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-DEPLOY ALERT for Verdant Health (customer=verdant-prod) — canary failures detected on dedicated pool `dedicated-verdant-pool`. Artifact attempted: `verdant-service@3.2.1-hotfix`. Healthchecks failing on canary nodes gpu-ved-1,gpu-ved-2. Root TS: 1785302468

sasha: taking this — oncall. paging @amit @jordan. Lia pls prep a short customer note (Verdant primary). Mike you’re backup oncall.

amit: looking now. Initial glance: inference runtime OOMs during long-context requests. Repeated stacktrace showing kv-cache resize failures, ejecting sessions. grabbing logs and metrics.

amit: log excerpt (truncated):
```
[2026-06-02T14:07:12Z] infer-engine: ERROR OOM while resizing kv_cache (requested=1.8GB, available=512MB)
[2026-06-02T14:07:12Z] infer-engine: trace: kv_cache::resize -> handler::alloc -> oom_error
[2026-06-02T14:07:12Z] healthcheck: failing /healthz (500) on node gpu-ved-2
```

jordan: infra shows the nodes reporting OOM, not network. GPU memory usage spikes on long prompt streams. Could be a regression in artifact 3.2.1-hotfix that changed prefetch/kv policy. Suggest we isolate canary and pin to previous stable artifact 3.2.0.

mike: I can cordon and drain the two failing canary nodes and stop routing new canary traffic. Command I’ll run:```
rwc pool cordon dedicated-verdant-pool --nodes gpu-ved-1,gpu-ved-2
rwc pool drain dedicated-verdant-pool --nodes gpu-ved-1,gpu-ved-2
```

lia: drafting customer note now. Draft: "Hi Verdant team — we detected elevated errors during today's canary for 3.2.1-hotfix on your dedicated pool. We're reverting the canary to the previous stable artifact (3.2.0) and monitoring. We expect minimal impact; we'll follow up with confirmation in ~15m." Send?

sasha: send that. Plan outline: 1) pause canary traffic for Verdant only, 2) pin dedicated-verdant-pool to artifact `3.2.0`, 3) drain/cordon failing canary nodes, 4) watch metrics for 10m, 5) escalate if errors persist. Anyone object?

carol: +1 from CSE side. CS will stand by for any customer questions. Lia, include the timeline and that this is an isolated dedicated pool (non-shared).

amit: confirming root cause hypothesis: memory growth tied to a change in prefetch window introduced in hotfix. Reverting should restore previous kv sizing behavior. I’ll capture heap profiles from the failing nodes before they’re drained.

sasha: execute revert when ready. Use pin+rolling-restart on pool (no global rollback). Command to run:```
# pin artifact back to stable and trigger pool apply
redwoodctl artifacts pin --customer verdant --pool dedicated-verdant-pool --artifact verdant-service@3.2.0
redwoodctl rollout apply --pool dedicated-verdant-pool --mode canary
```

mike: executing pin now.

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin artifact started by mike. Command output: `pin request accepted (request_id=pin-9f3b)`.

jordan: draining nodes now. `rwc pool drain dedicated-verdant-pool --nodes gpu-ved-1,gpu-ved-2` -> success, pods evicted and rescheduled on healthy nodes.

amit: captured heap profiles and kv cache stats, storing to s3: `s3://rdw-incident-logs/verdant/1785302468/`. Will attach to postmortem.

mike: monitoring metrics — error-rate for dedicated-verdant-pool dropping toward baseline. p50 latency trending back to normal. No customer 503s reported in last 2m.

lia: customer note sent via support portal and DM to Verdant primary. They asked for ETA; I replied ~15m for confirmation.

sasha: handing off monitoring to mike for 2 hours. I’ll update oncall rotation if anything pops. If we see >1% error-rate for >5m we re-escalate to P0 and consider full rollback of any remaining canaries.

carol: suggested action items for follow-up (will add to incident): - add a canary test triggering long-context kv load, - add probe for kv cache resize OOM, - revert change in prefetch window in next dev cycle or add a config flag, - improve pinned-artifact runbook to include capture steps.

amit: will open PR to add config guard and add a flag to limit prefetch size per-customer.

sasha: thanks team. Current state: artifact pinned -> 3.2.0, failing nodes drained, customer notified, metrics stable. Leaving thread open for handoff notes; closing after 30m stable unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:
